summary: XRP ~$1.26, down with the market despite a strong Ripple Swell close: ~$900M annualised revenue, bank partners (Standard Chartered, HSBC, BNY) and final OCC approval for a national trust bank charter, with Treasury Secretary Bessent on stage. X chatter has fallen back sharply after the Swell spike.
catalyst_note: Ripple final OCC national trust bank charter approval announced at Swell, 27-29 Oct
